title: Exauctorate
summary: EXAUC'TORATE EXAUCTORA'TION EXAU'THORATE, verb transitive [Latin exauctoro; ex and auctoro, to hire or bind, from auctor, author.] To dismiss from service; to deprive of a benefice.
